{{Quote|The nature-loving Ithorians know a thing or two about what makes a great salad. This is our take on the traditional covado salad~mixed Ithorian greens garnished with starfruit and hardboiled ooglata eggs. Served with Meerian vinaigrette.|Dex's Diner menu on the Herd ship's bounty salad|<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Herd ship's bounty salad''' was a type of [[Salad/Legends|salad]] based on the traditional [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[covado salad]]. It consisted of mixed Ithorian greens garnished with [[Starfruit/Legends|starfruit]] and hard-boiled [[Ooglata]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] and served with a [[Meerian vinaigrette]]. It was served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 4.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and for an additional credit [[hoyy seed]]s or [[Liwi fruit/Legends|liwi fruit]] would be added.
